independenceStatement: The Mercy Wanjau Foundation is an independent, non-partisan, not-for-profit organisation. It is not part of, and does not act on behalf of, any government office, and it does not engage in political campaigning. Gifts to the Foundation do not create any expectation of access, influence or favour.
officialChannels: The Foundation only receives donations through the M-PESA and card channels listed on this website. We never ask for payment in exchange for jobs, scholarships, sponsorship or support. If someone contacts you claiming to represent the Foundation and asks for money, please verify with us at info@mw-foundation.org.
